## Outcome (2026-11-09, times PST)
- Release commit fd2cae3925e3b05992cdad5ed53e4d85128ed78c (rebase of ab534d1b382 onto aa9828f9a2b; same Change-Id, rebar-ticket trailer and Signed-off-by). Local `make verify` passed on it: 20,850 passed / 29 skipped default tier, 202 passed / 2 skipped integration. Pinned release-toolchain build + `twine check` PASSED (wheel and sdist) on the bump; release.yml's build job re-ran the hash-locked build on fd2cae3925e.
- Gerrit change 3335 patch set 2: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (CI run 42738438802, 27 jobs success incl. all 7 mutation shards), no unresolved comments; submitted 18:17 via gerrit_safe_submit.py --revision fd2cae3925e3b05992cdad5ed53e4d85128ed78c, status MERGED; GitHub mirror main = fd2cae3925e at 18:17. Patch set 1 had Verified -1 from the ubuntu-26.04 mutation-sandbox defect (unwasteful-increased-colt, fixed by aa9828f9a2b).
- release.yml run 42741796277 dispatched from main (head fd2cae3925e) with version=0.15.0; pypi deployment approved 18:24 by JoeOakhartNava; conclusion success, all 10 jobs success (authorize, build, wheel/sdist tests, publish, mcp_registry, github_release, evidence).
- PyPI: info.version 0.15.0; files nava_rebar-0.15.0-py3-none-any.whl and nava_rebar-0.15.0.tar.gz.
- GitHub: Release v0.15.0, not draft/prerelease, releases/latest = v0.15.0, assets wheel + sdist + SHA256SUMS; tag v0.15.0 -> commit fd2cae3925e.
- MCP Registry: io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.15.0 isLatest=true, published 18:24.
- Homebrew: PENDING OPERATOR. Formula/rebar.rb still points at nava_rebar-0.13.1.tar.gz; autobump.yml is disabled_inactivity. Re-enabling it is the operator's decision; tracked in hedonistic-historical-graywolf (linked discovered_from). Not a release failure.
- Probe: `pipx install "nava-rebar[mcp]==0.15.0" --force` (installed 0.15.0, baked COMMIT fd2cae3), then scripts/probe_rebar.py with REBAR at the pipx binary, no PROBE_LIVE: PROBE RESULT: 142 passed, 0 failed (mode: ISOLATED (temp tracker)).
- Filed during the release: unwasteful-increased-colt (mutation sandbox, closed), hedonistic-historical-graywolf (Homebrew autobump), expansive-aromatic-whippet (local build/twine check false failure), inner-benign-sable (tag-type doc drift).
